evidence: scrollaway credits Person of Interest with inspiring an AI study and career path; ghaff enjoyed it initially but lost interest over time.

evidence_sources.author: scrollaway
evidence_sources.excerpt: I watched the show in 2014 and it drove my interest to study and work in the AI sector (today I run an AI lab, whose name comes from that tv show).

evidence_sources.author: ghaff
evidence_sources.excerpt: I enjoyed it for a bit but it was one of those shows that just didn't grab me after a while.
